description: This file defines utility functions, types, and helpers for managing chat channels and plugin registration within the plugin SDK of the project. It includes functions for creating channel metadata, resolving security and threading options, and building outbound session routes, as well as plugin registration helpers.

classes.name: ChannelMeta
classes.description: Represents metadata for a chat channel, including labels, docs, and configuration options.

classes.name: ChannelOutboundSessionRoute
classes.description: Defines the structure for outbound session routing information used in channel messaging.

classes.name: ChatChannelPluginBase
classes.description: Base type for chat channel plugins, omitting certain optional properties for customization.

classes.name: ChatChannelSecurityOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for security policies in chat channels, including direct message policies.

classes.name: ChatChannelPairingOptions
classes.description: Options for pairing channels with text-based approval and notification.

classes.name: ChatChannelThreadingReplyModeOptions
classes.description: Options for reply threading modes in chat channels, supporting top-level and scoped reply modes.

classes.name: ChatChannelThreadingOptions
classes.description: Combined options for reply threading, including reply mode resolution.

classes.name: ChatChannelAttachedOutboundOptions
classes.description: Configuration for outbound message results attached to a channel.

classes.name: MaybePromise
classes.description: Type alias for a value T or a Promise resolving to T, used for async functions.

classes.name: CreatedChannelPluginBase
classes.description: Type representing a created channel plugin with optional properties and setup.

methods.name: createInlineTextPairingAdapter
methods.description: Creates a pairing adapter for inline text-based approval notifications.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelSecurity
methods.description: Resolves security configuration for chat channels, including DM policies.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelPairing
methods.description: Resolves pairing configuration for chat channels, supporting inline text pairing.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelThreading
methods.description: Resolves threading options for chat channels, including reply mode resolution.

methods.name: resolveChatChannelOutbound
methods.description: Resolves outbound message configuration, including attached results.

methods.name: createChatChannelPlugin
methods.description: Builds a chat channel plugin with security, pairing, threading, and outbound options.

methods.name: createChannelPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base object for channel plugins with optional properties and metadata.

methods.name: defineChannelPluginEntry
methods.description: Defines a plugin entry for a channel, handling registration and configuration.

methods.name: defineSetupPluginEntry
methods.description: Defines a minimal setup entry for a plugin, primarily exporting the plugin object.
